title: Continual Learning with Multilingual Foundation Model

bias_targets.methodology: Performing frequency distribution and Chi-square analysis to detect statistical imbalances between labels across English, Spanish, and Italian datasets, and evaluating language-specific variations in model confidence scores to optimize decision boundaries via ROC analysis.

Evaluating the model's ability to distinguish between actual hate speech and reclaimed LGBTQ+ slurs (reappropriated for self-empowerment) by tracking macro-averaged F1, precision, and recall metrics to avoid disproportionately flagging marginalized community speech as toxic.

Measuring severe class imbalance (reclamatory vs. non-reclamatory usage) through descriptive analytics and evaluating model robustness to this imbalance using stratified 5-fold cross-validation and fold-wise F1 stability.
